purpose: Operator directive Step 5: the TVM must search for a technological frontier using the underlying CAPABILITY, not merely the terminology appearing in the death record. This typed layer maps an exact recorded capability to a capability family, measurement dimension, required regime, target constraints, and a deterministic closed search vocabulary.
population_note: The experiment's family entries must ultimately be derived from the recorded technical-death records of the R411/R412 population (limiting capability -> family). THAT POPULATION IS NOT PRESENT IN THIS WORKSPACE (see R412_GRADIENT_V1_INSTRUMENT_FINDING.json). Exactly ONE entry is seeded here, taken verbatim from the operator directive's own example, with derivation_status EXPLORATORY_HYPOTHESIS and provenance OPERATOR_DIRECTIVE_EXAMPLE. No other families are invented: inventing them would embed an unproven solution class into the search (Constitution Article XLIII). Additional entries require the recovered population or explicit operator authorization, added as a NEW frozen version of this map.

family_schema.lookup_semantics: exact key match on exact_capability or an alias only; NO fuzzy matching; a miss returns an EMPTY list (recorded, never guessed)

families.measurement_dimension: positioning error, disturbance rejection, closed-loop bandwidth

provenance.quote: Example: '10-100x misalignment vs deflection' -> actuation/control precision -> dynamic positioning -> closed-loop disturbance rejection
provenance.note: The exact transformation from the recorded limiting capability to a measured frontier still requires evidence; this vocabulary only widens the SEARCH, it establishes nothing by itself.
